name: docker

scripts.conformance: for c in docker.ps docker.logs docker.exec docker.control; do case $c in docker.ps) A='{"limit":5}';; docker.logs) A='{"container":"nonexistent","tail":10}';; docker.exec) A='{"container":"nonexistent","argv":["true"]}';; docker.control) A='{"container":"nonexistent","action":"start"}';; esac; npx tsx ${CAK_HOME:-$HOME/agent-kernel}/bin/cak.ts conformance --subprocess "node dist/main.js" --contract $c --contracts ${CAK_REGISTRY:-$HOME/cak-registry}/contracts/community --args "$A" || exit 1; done

description: CAK 插件：看容器/读日志/容器内执行/起停容器（docker.ps@1 / docker.logs@1 / docker.exec@1 / docker.control@1），走本机 docker CLI，不做删除
